avis.titre: My Results Support The Science Behind Retinoids
avis.texte: I have spent a large majority of my 22 years in the New Mexican sun, and while I have been very good about sunscreen the last couple of years the sun damage of my youth has caught up to me and I found myself with 3 forehead wrinkles and a scattering of freckles and sunspots. While it might seem insignificant to some I hate to think what I'd look like at 40 if I already have signs of aging. So I did a lot of research into proven wrinkle treatment and in my search I discovered something. There are millions, MILLIONS of products, home remedies, and concoctions that claim to prevent wrinkles, treat wrinkles, make them disappear, and do a number of other things. However the ONLY FDA APPROVED ANTI AGING INGREDIENT is the various strands of RETINOIDS. That doesnt mean that nothing else out there works, but it means that the only one that has enough strong scientific evidence to be considered a treatment for anti aging is products containing some type of retinoid. When you go to a dermatologist for wrinkle cream, you will very likely receive a prescription strength retinoid because it is proven to work. What are retinoids exactly and what is the difference between the various types? Retinoids are essentially vitamin A, their structures vary in each of the three generations but generally all the retinoids found in anti wrinkle creams are first generation. They are in fact natural ingredients found in plants and animals and we consume them in our daily diets. Researching the various ty

If you love Roc (and I am a HUGE fan), I recommend using Bel Essence with it, to get the good effects of Roc without the bad. avis.titre: These diverse compounds naturally occur everywhere in our bodies and are vital to internal processes like immune functio
avis.texte: my review is kind of meaningless. if you want something to help with wrinkles, you need to be a realist: accept your age, your bone structure (my forehead is flat, not round, so i have expression lines at 36 years old) and how you've treated your skin thus far. I have copied some information that is fact--retinol vs retinoid: Retinoids The term “retinoid” describes a family of ingredients that includes both Retin-A and retinol. Retinoids are a class of ingredients chemically related to vitamin A. These diverse compounds naturally occur everywhere in our bodies and are vital to internal processes like immune function and tissue repair. When looking at skincare products, it’s important to remember that “retinoid” is an umbrella term and doesn’t specify the type of retinoid compound in the formula. The only type of retinoid that your skin is able to process immediately is retinoic acid. All other forms of retinoids have to be converted by skin enzymes into retinoic acid before the skin is able to use it. How much conversion your enzymes have to do to change a retinoid into retinoic acid determines the strength and use of the retinoid. Retinol Retinol is a specific form of vitamin A that is naturally produced in your body. When it’s applied topically, enzymes in your skin convert retinol into retinaldehyde and then into retinoic acid. avis.titre: Can you see the difference in my frown lines?Can you see the difference in my frown lines?
avis.texte: I’ve used other retinol products with varying results, but I decided to take a chance on this one because Google listed it as one of the top products for effectiveness against signs of aging. HOW I USE: I apply this retinol cream to my wrinkles and lines every evening, then follow-up with a good night cream, (it leaves my skin too dry when used alone). I began with every-night use right away (it is recommended to start gradually with every-other-night vs nightly, but my skin is not sensitive, so I jumped right in without regrets; if you have sensitive skin, I would suggest easing into using, as the instructions state). MY EXPERIENCE: The first few times using this cream, I felt a slight burning sensation (mostly between my eyebrows area). I suppose that was my skin getting used to the retinol. After the very first application, I noticed my smile lines, the lines leading from my nose to my mouth, seemed to reduce substantially. Then, within a couple of days of use, the frown lines between my eyebrows began to lessen. I’ve used this product every night for a little over 2 weeks now, and my skin feels smoother and more youthful. Unfortunately, it has caused a few breakouts, too. Mostly at the end of the first week (maybe it was my skin getting used to this level of retinol). I haven’t noticed much difference in the wrinkles above my lip (some call them smoker’s lines, but I’m not a smoker). Sometimes, I accidentally lick that area, and let me tell you, retinol does not taste goo

I thought to myself: 'So this is what it's like to turn 70, as the skin cells harden like old dry leather. It was very uncomfortable physically, the sensation of unyielding, tight dryness. Then I read the good reviews on this particular product, RoC Retinol Correction Deep Wrinkle Night Cream. I thought, Why not try it - it's not too pricey and I could afford this. So glad I did! Almost immediately it began to work wonders! My skin feels normal again, like tender, soft, clean young skin - well, as soft as a 70 year old can get. My skin looks and feels better after only a week's worth of bedtime application. No lines are disappearing, but they appear softer, if that makes sense. My makeup glides on more smoothly and my skin looks distinctly softer/better, more luminous. I would definitely recommend this one for the over 65 crowd. After the application dries down on your face, in 10 minutes or so, you can apply a natural, healthy none toxic moisturizer. It helps to relieve some of the burning.

While I do have access to medical grade skincare, I went with this retinol because it has a lower percentage of retinol and I have sensitive skin. I started use to target fine lines around my eyes, a deeper wrinkle on my forehead, and to reduce my pore size. I have used this product for right over 7 weeks daily at night. Some of the reviews mentioned excessive dryness/flakiness/redness. That is an anticipated reaction when starting a retinol as well as skin purging aka sudden breakouts. I experienced all of that around probably the 1.5 week mark and the symptoms stopped around the 3 week mark. Since then, I’ve had dryness (which is to be expected) and I’ve seen a huge change in the texture and radiance of my skin. I think this is a great starter retinol for someone with any skin type. I think it’s important to note that if you have deep wrinkles/sagging, this is not the retinol for you. This will not be strong enough to erase them. It can help to minimize them but you’ll need to look elsewhere to completely get rid of them. All in all, super happy with this product!! My skin is so much more vibrant after use.
